test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She was annoyed ________ the noise.
solution:
The correct answer is '**at**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**at**" is commonly used to express annoyance or displeasure in relation to a specific cause, such as noise.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"She was annoyed **at**__ the noise."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "by"** is incorrect as it does not express the correct relationship of annoyance with the noise.
 
• **Option 2: "to"** is incorrect because "to" does not fit the construction of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "with"** is inappropriate here as it is more commonly used for people or groups.
